Colleagues,

I'm excited to share that the University of Arizona's CS department has two open positions this year. We welcome applicants across all areas of computer science, including visualization and human-computer interaction (HCI).
We are particularly excited about opportunities to strengthen our research community and foster interdisciplinary collaborations across computing, cognitive science, and related fields.

Open Positions:
Assistant/Associate/Full Professor, Computer Science (Tenure-Track/Tenured) — Open to all areas of computer science. Apply here <

>. Preferred deadline: November 15, 2026.

Associate/Full Professor, Computer Science and Director of Cognitive Science (Tenured) — Seeking candidates working in AI and related areas, including HCI, visualization, and visual perception. Apply here <
